import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Start the scan (scanning from bottom to top)
print("Starting AFM scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

    print(f"Last saved image path: {last_saved_file}")

    print(f"Current directory: {cwd}")
    files = [f for f in os.listdir(cwd) if f.endswith(('.nid', '.png', '.jpg'))]
    print(f"Image files in directory: {files}")
    if files:
        last_saved_file = os.path.join(cwd, files[-1])
